entries.title: Matthew 19:1
segments: And it happened, when Jesus had finished these sayings, that He departed from Galilee and came into the borders of Judea beyond Jordan.

entries.title: Matthew 19:2
segments: And great crowds followed Him. And He healed them there.

entries.title: Matthew 19:3
segments: And the Pharisees came to Him, tempting Him and saying to Him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?

entries.title: Matthew 19:4
segments: And He answered and said to them, Have you not read that He who made [them] at the beginning "made them male and female",

entries.title: Matthew 19:5
segments: and said, "For this cause a man shall leave father and mother and shall cling to his wife, and the two of them shall be one flesh?"

entries.title: Matthew 19:6
segments: "Therefore they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let not man separate."

entries.title: Matthew 19:7
segments: They said to Him, Why did Moses then command to give a bill of divorce and to put her away?

entries.title: Matthew 19:8
segments: He said to them, Because of your hard-heartedness Moses allowed you to put away your wives; but from the beginning it was not so.

entries.title: Matthew 19:9
segments: And I say to you, Whoever shall put away his wife, except for fornication, and shall marry another, commits adultery; and whoever marries her [who is] put away commits adultery.

entries.title: Matthew 19:10
segments: His disciples said to Him, If this is the case of the man with [his] wife, it is not good to marry.

entries.title: Matthew 19:11
segments: But He said to them, Not all receive this word, except [those] to whom it is given.

entries.title: Matthew 19:12
segments: For there are some eunuchs who were born so from [their] mother's womb; and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of Heaven's sake. He who is able to receive [it], let him receive it.

entries.title: Matthew 19:13
segments: Then little children were brought to Him, that He should put [His] hands on them and pray. And the disciples rebuked them.

entries.title: Matthew 19:14
segments: But Jesus said, Allow the little children to come to Me, and do not forbid them; for of such is the kingdom of Heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 19:15
segments: And He laid [His] hands on them, and departed from there.

entries.title: Matthew 19:16
segments: And behold, one came and said to Him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do that I may have eternal life?

entries.title: Matthew 19:17
segments: And He said to him, Why do you call Me good? [There is] none good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.

entries.title: Matthew 19:18
segments: He said to Him, Which? Jesus said, You shall not murder, you shall not commit adultery, you shall not steal, you shall not bear false witness,

entries.title: Matthew 19:19
segments: honor your father and mother, and, you shall love your neighbor as yourself.

entries.title: Matthew 19:20
segments: The young man said to Him, I have kept all these things from my youth up; what do I lack yet?

entries.title: Matthew 19:21
segments: Jesus said to him, If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have and give to [the] poor, and you shall have treasure in Heaven. And come, follow Me.

entries.title: Matthew 19:22
segments: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful; for he had great possessions.

entries.title: Matthew 19:23
segments: Then Jesus said to His disciples, Truly I say to you that a rich man will with great difficulty enter into the kingdom of Heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 19:24
segments: And again I say to you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

entries.title: Matthew 19:25
segments: When His disciples heard, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?

entries.title: Matthew 19:26
segments: But Jesus looked on [them] and said to them, With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.

entries.title: Matthew 19:27
segments: Then answering Peter said to Him, Behold, we have forsaken all and have followed You. Therefore what shall we have?

entries.title: Matthew 19:28
segments: And Jesus said to them, Truly I say to you that you who have followed Me, in the regeneration, when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of His glory, you also shall sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

entries.title: Matthew 19:29
segments: And everyone who left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for My name's sake, shall receive a hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.

entries.title: Matthew 19:30
segments: But many [who are] first shall be last; and the last [shall be] first.
